MrFujiText:
MR.FUJI: Welcome.

Hmm… You appear to
be raising your

#MON in a kind
and loving manner.

#MON lovers
come here to pay

their respects to
departed #MON.

Please offer con-
dolences for the

souls of the de-
parted #MON.

I'm sure that will
make them happy.
SoulHouseTeacherText:
There are other
graves of #MON here, I think.

There are many
chambers that only MR.FUJI may enter.
SoulHouseLassText:
I came with my mom
to visit #MON graves…
SoulHouseGrannyText:
The #MON that
lived with me…

I loved them like
my grandchildren…
